description: The bar chart illustrates values of the metric labeled “γ/B” for two outcome categories, “Incorrect” and “Correct,” across different “Number of Shots” settings. The horizontal axis contains the categories 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4 (in ascending numeric order) and is labeled “Number of Shots,” while the vertical axis is labeled “γ/B” and uses a linear scale from 0.0 up to about 0.8, with regularly spaced tick marks at approximately 0.2 intervals (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6). For each shot count, there are two side-by-side bars: an “Incorrect” bar shown in blue with a dotted hatch pattern and a “Correct” bar shown in maroon with a diagonal hatch pattern, as indicated by the legend at the top. At 0 shots, the Incorrect bar is around 0.41 and the Correct bar is around 0.72; at 1 shot, Incorrect is about 0.40 and Correct about 0.68; at 2 shots, Incorrect is about 0.37 and Correct about 0.65; at 3 shots, Incorrect is about 0.33 and Correct about 0.63; and at 4 shots, Incorrect is about 0.30 and Correct about 0.45. The bars are grouped by shot count (two bars per group) with no stacking, and there are no additional annotations or visual emphasis beyond the color/hatch styling and the legend.
